hunt.text: Auto attacks and uses your skills for you. It works only in fields like this street; bosses and story moments are always yours to play.

rest.text: Tap Sit. You recover Health and Zeal three times faster while sitting. Moving stands you up.

fight.text: Foes can drop gear and Denarii. Gear goes to More → Equipment; the Provisioner by the street sells bread.

stones.text: New: ground matters. The mire slows you and drains Health. The pale stepping stones are firm: walk from stone to stone.

mire.text: Job Level 3 opens Take Refuge (More → Skills). It heals you in a fight; keep it on your skill bar.

study.text: New: the means of grace. Reading here gives Manna and teaches Prayer of Rest, a skill that restores Zeal. Learn it in More → Skills.

shining.text: New: your status changed. The Burden chip is gone from your plate and you move at full speed. Steady Footing (a passive skill) is now open in Skills.

climb.text: New: buffs. Watchful Eye is open in Skills. Use it before a hard fight: more critical hits for a few seconds.

byways.text: A field boss! Red circles show where the blow will land. Walk out of them. A wide ring means a slam: get well clear.

armor.text: New: the Armor of God. It is the same for every pilgrim and is never sold or upgraded. See it in More → Equipment.

muster.text: New: companions. For a Muster, Lumen, Rook and a Steward fight beside you. They act by themselves; you play your own part.

calling.text: Your Calling's skills go on the last page of the skill bar. Tap the page button to switch.

prove.text: The lent skill is on the last page of your skill bar. Tap the page button, then the skill.

hunt.text: New: weaknesses. Each family of sin gives way to a virtue. Pride gives way to Wisdom, Wrath to Steadfastness. See More → Codex.

apollyon.text: Apollyon throws darts from afar. Below half Health he throws several at once: keep moving between the circles.

narrow.text: The ditch is on one hand and the quag on the other. Keep to the glowing waypoints; do not hurry.

fiends.text: New: All-Prayer. The fiends cannot be hurt by your staff or other skills. Use All-Prayer (your skill bar; tap the page button).
